FermionBoson.title: Fermion and boson composition classes
FermionBoson.statement: Constituents divide into alternating and preserving exchange-composition classes according to their finite cyclic spin action; the former exclude duplicate one-cell words and the latter admit them.
FermionBoson.generation_rule: Generate the complete constituent, composition/exchange, conserved-label, transition-channel, provenance, target-access, successor and extra-rule product.
FermionBoson.grammar_boundary: All finite material forms generated from exact physical Fold words, held orientations, closed transfer, phase recurrence and complete observation support without imported particle taxonomy or fitted coupling.
